description: Deterministic all-pair evidence pointers. No generated prose; all original text stays in corpus.json.

certaintyRules.coMention: Both aliases appear in one original story paragraph. It is NOT proof of physical co-presence.
certaintyRules.speakerExchange: Two different explicit speaker labels occur consecutively in local text without detected scene barrier. Candidate conversational exchange, not proof of in-person conversation.
certaintyRules.thirdPartyDiscussion: A third speaker names one person, followed by the other person's response. Indirect topic reference; no direct interaction asserted.
certaintyRules.twins: Group reference only when the actual word Twins/Twin appears or BOTH Bantu and Bobby are named in the same story paragraph. Bantu-only/Bobby-only records are not group interactions.
certaintyRules.ron: The single Ron speaker in EP10 is unresolved and must not be merged with husband John without source confirmation.
certaintyRules.noEvidence: No qualifying textual evidence; does not prove absence of untagged pronoun-only scenes.
certaintyRules.boundaryFilter: Speaker and indirect-reference candidates may not cross source-part changes, detected location/time transitions, or phone/group-message transitions. Third-party replies must be within 2 source paragraphs.
